Ottawa accelerates infrastructure and procurement activity across federal sectors. 🇨🇦

Clean Energy & Infrastructure: Prime Minister Carney announced a $70 billion investment, the largest in North American history, targeting industrial-scale grid electrification in the Labrador Trough with HVDC transmission, green hydrogen, and critical mineral processing. Enterprises should pivot to become 'Integration Leads' for MPO projects, securing tier-two engineering and environmental monitoring sub-contracts.

Government Procurement: Minister Valdez launched the Small Business Procurement Program (SBPP) with a $79.9 million budget over five years via Innovative Solutions Canada to lower barriers for SMEs, focusing on B2B portals and matching algorithms. Canadian technology SMEs should apply for ISC funding to test, scale, and sell software solutions to federal entities.

Climate Resilience & Infrastructure: Environment and Climate Change Canada and the Federation of Canadian Municipalities are deploying $34.2 million across 141 municipal adaptation projects under the Green Municipal Fund, requiring engineering, GIS modeling, and climate risk assessments. Offer consulting services focused on standardized regional climate adaptation modeling and asset integration to help municipalities deploy their grants.

Housing & Construction: The 'Build Canada Homes' initiative signals a multi-billion dollar federal push for affordable housing using public-private partnerships and industrialized construction methods like prefabrication and modular building, emphasizing Canadian tech, labor, and lumber. Form cross-sector consortia combining modular construction, sustainable forestry, and advanced manufacturing expertise for large-scale green housing solutions.

Indigenous Engagement & Policy: Public Safety Canada is seeking feedback on Indigenous engagement services for the Firearms Classification Review, requiring consultation strategies aligned with modern treaties and the PSIB, focusing on culturally aligned Indigenous data governance. Submit technical feedback to Public Safety Canada outlining secure, cloud-based data sovereignty-compliant platforms for regional treaty group coordination.
